title: Sentinel canonical rule v1
description: Normative schema for stored rule documents (schema_version 'sentinel-rule/v1'). Stage-5 companion to Stage-1 section 6.2: extends the Stage-1 canonical rule document ADDITIVELY (no Stage-1 field removed or reinterpreted). Seven kinds: sigma, correlation, ioc, fim, sca, statistical, artifact. Rule content is untrusted input; the JSON schema is the first gate, the lint engine (Stage-5 section 3) is the second. Verbatim upstream YAML is NOT stored here; it is stored separately in rule_source (Stage-5 D5-001).

id.description: Stable identifier, never rewritten on reimport. Sigma/correlation/imported rules use a UUID (uuid-v4 shape, e.g. 8c3b2f1a-...); Stage-3 artifact fact-to-finding rules keep their AF-xxx ids verbatim (stage-3 section 12.4).

kind.description: Detector family discriminator. Derived at import when absent in upstream (artifact = Stage-3 fact-to-finding rules; ioc/fim/sca/statistical = native rules).

source.description: Stage-1 6.2 vocabulary, unchanged. Native rules (ioc/fim/sca/statistical/artifact authored by Sentinel) use 'native'.

source_id.description: Upstream rule id verbatim (e.g. Sigma rule id). Absent for native rules.

source_ref.description: repo@commit:path provenance for imported rules; pack-relative path for native rules.

source_spec.description: Spec the upstream rule was parsed against, e.g. 'sigma-spec/2.1.0'.

license.description: SPDX-ish identifier driving attribution obligations, e.g. 'DRL-1.1', 'CC0-1.0', 'Apache-2.0'.

author.description: REQUIRED for every rule (DRL 1.1 obligation: author identification must flow to alerts and exports).

name.description: Unique human-readable name usable as a correlation reference (sigma-spec correlation rules 4.1.3).

status.description: Verbatim upstream status for imported rules (never rewritten); native rules adopt the same vocabulary.

level_original.description: Upstream/fidelity axis (Stage-1 6.4), verbatim, never collapsed into severity.

severity.description: Product-facing detection severity, exactly three levels (Stage-1 6.4). Map: informational|low->LOW, medium->MEDIUM, high|critical->HIGH.

tags.description: Namespaced tags preserved verbatim (e.g. attack.t1560.001). ATT&CK-derived data carries the MITRE copyright designation in pack NOTICE and exports (Stage-5 10.3).

fields.description: Analyst-display field hints (sigma-spec rules 4.13), recorded, not evaluated.

scope.description: sigma-spec rules 4.15 scope (e.g. server). Stored; deployment gating is Stage-6.

when.description: Fact predicates over artifact facts (kind=artifact only; keys identical to Stage-3 AF rules).

emit.description: artifact_finding emission (kind=artifact only; keys identical to Stage-3 AF rules).

severity_hint.description: Stage-3 AF rules place this at rule level (stage-3 12.4); accepted there verbatim for kind=artifact only. UI hint; detectors own real severity.

attribution.description: Stage-3 AF rule-level attribution string (DRL-compatible), accepted at rule level for kind=artifact only; also accepted inside emit.

rationale.description: Why this rule exists (required for native rules at review; not schema-enforced).

rule_source_sha256.description: Digest of the verbatim source document stored in rule_source.

governance.description: Pack governance state (Stage-5 section 10). Absent = governed by pack-level metadata only.

kill_switch.description: true = rule is force-disabled regardless of enabled.

then.description: when/emit/severity_hint/attribution are Stage-3 artifact-rule keys and are only valid on kind=artifact (Stage-5 D5-001).

logsource.description: sigma-spec rules 3.3. Lower-case values, '_' for spaces. Only these three evaluatable keys plus free-text definition; Stage-2 sigma_field_mapping_pipelines.yaml selects the pipeline from this logsource (D2-014).

condition.description: Sigma condition expression. Grammar validated by the lint engine, not by JSON schema: identifiers, and/or/not, parentheses, '1/all of them', 'n of pattern', bare keyword identifiers, condition-as-list (OR across items).

search_identifier.description: A search identifier is either a list (OR across items) or a map (AND across fields). List items are maps (AND within item, OR across items) or strings (keyword search over the whole canonical event).

propertyNames.description: Field name, optionally with '|modifier[|modifier...]' suffixes. ':' forbidden (YAML key boundary).

sigma_value.description: Scalar, list, empty string ('' = empty value) or null (sigma-spec rules 4.4.4: null is its own type, never mixed into a list of other values; lint enforces the mixing ban).

type.description: All 7 types of spec 2.1.0. NOTE (VERIFIED): the spec's own 'allowed values' list at correlation-rules-specification.md line 236 still names only the first four; value_sum/value_avg/value_percentile are defined in sections 4.5-4.7 and History confirms their addition in 2.1.0.

rules.description: Referenced rule UUIDs or unique names (id-or-name index built at load; name resolution is mandatory per spec).

aliases.description: Field-name aliases applied to referenced rules' outputs before group-by (spec: Field Name Aliases).

group-by.description: Canonical field paths (post-pipeline). Multiple fields are ANDed.

timespan.description: number + lowercase unit; '90m' for 1h30 (spec Time Selection).

generate.description: true = also convert referred rules as standalone detectors (default false, spec Generate).

then.description: temporal types require no condition (spec: Requires lists).
metric types require condition.field (spec: 'field in condition section').

correlation_condition.description: Exactly one criterion, or a range expressed as two keys ANDed (spec Condition).

ioc.description: IOC watchlist rule (Stage-5 section 6). Indicator VALUES never live in rule documents; they live in Ed25519-signed packs (D4-003).

subset.description: Optional named subset inside the pack (e.g. 'botnet-c2').

fields.description: Canonical field paths to test (e.g. file.hashes.sha256, network.dst_ip, dns.query_name).

confirm_exact.description: default true: Bloom prefilter then exact-set confirm (Stage-5 6.4).

on_stale.description: Behaviour when the signed pack cannot be refreshed at job start (cold-start policy, Stage-5 4.8).

emit_fields.description: Canonical fields copied into the finding evidence.

fim.description: File-integrity rule over fim/file canonical events and optional uploaded baseline pairs (Stage-5 section 7). Live-host FIM is out of scope (Stage-1 4.2).

include.description: Glob patterns over canonical file paths (case-insensitive on Windows; '\' and '/' equivalent).

baseline.description: Where the 'expected' state comes from when the event carries no old/new pair.

match_event_fields.description: Optional predicate map over the fim payload (e.g. fim.operation: audit_log_cleared), evaluated with sigma operators.

sca.description: Configuration-assessment rule over config_check canonical events and our own check packs (Stage-5 section 8). No CIS/SCAP text may be shipped; benchmark.* is a factual reference only.

fail_status_only.description: true = fire only on config_check.status = 'fail' (default true). Absent evidence never counts as pass (Stage-5 8.5).

note.description: Must state that wording is Sentinel's own; CIS Benchmark PDFs are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for non-commercial use (Stage-1 2.1, Stage-5 10.3).

evidence.description: Canonical field paths copied into the finding evidence.

statistical.description: Declarative statistical rule (Stage-5 section 9). No ML (Stage-1 4.3). All numbers here are CONTENT, editable without redeploying the engine.

warmup_action.description: suppress = no finding until min_observations (default); flag = emit with baseline.warmup=true.

k.description: Robust z multiplier for median_mad (x > median + k * 1.4826 * MAD).

scope_filter.description: Optional sigma-style predicate restricting which events enter the baseline (e.g. event.category: process).

fact_predicate.description: One fact plus exactly one operator key (Stage-3 12.4 vocabulary, extended with lt/lte/neq/contains/regex).

fact.description: Namespaced fact name, e.g. archive.entry.ratio, motw.zone_id, pe.import.name.

regex.description: RE2 subset only (D5-004); lint rejects constructs outside sigma-spec's own restricted regex flavor.

in_list_ref.description: Pack-relative list file (e.g. lists/exec_apis.yaml); resolved at load, content-addressed, size-capped (D5-019).

finding.description: Rule id or configuration-defined rule name - never free text, never a verdict (Stage-3 D3-029).

severity_hint.description: UI hint only; detectors own real severity (Stage-3 12.4).

attribution.description: DRL-compatible attribution block for the emitted finding.

detection_path.description: Stage-1 D-004: sql primary, native fallback + conformance oracle.

sql.description: Compiled artifact stored per rule as evidence (never re-parsed at runtime).

column.description: Indexable envelope column, e.g. event.category, event.type, source.channel, source.event_id.

code.description: Reason code, e.g. UNSUPPORTED_MODIFIER, UNMAPPED_FIELD, REGEX_TIMEOUT_QUARANTINE.

selector.description: Which detection identifier / field the code refers to.
